title: Quadruply-Graded Colored Homology of Knots
note: arXiv:1304.3481v1 [math.QA], Fund. Math. 243 (2018) 209-299. Added 2026-08-02 from library/arxiv-1304.3481v1/1304.3481v1.pdf (authors verified: Eugene Gorsky, Sergei Gukov, Marko Stošić). Refined (quadruple) grading on the colored HOMFLY homology of the Gukov–Stošić BPS-states picture, with the physical realization by counting supersymmetric configurations (BPS states, instantons, vortices). Companion to gukov-stosic2012 in the QOU $A_\omega$ non-degeneracy assessment.
